title: Rheumatoid arthritis finger stick RNA sequence data
description: This is a longitudinal study of 355 blood samples collected weekly from 5 patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis with varying disease activity over the course of one to five years. Blood samples were self collected from finger sticks and mailed from home. RNA was extracted, purified and sequenced.
